history_model.actor_authorization: Actor attribution and role/identity claims are recorded separately from authority verification. UNCONFIGURED policy blocks authority-dependent actions. Test-only policy is available only to synthetic tests.
history_model.application_semantics: Lifecycle APIs return copied records and appended events. V4 package validation independently checks event contracts, record/event links, materialized state replay, exact current review/acceptance links, evidence eligibility for decisions, unique collection cardinality, and chronological causal order.
history_model.causal_order: Authorization time <= dispatch sent time <= response received time <= review time <= acceptance time <= decision resolution time when those linked records exist. Event log timestamps are globally nondecreasing; cross-entity evidence dependencies are checked by record references and timestamps.
history_model.decision_evidence: Every resolution reference must identify exactly one evidence result in ACCEPTED state with a current ACCEPTED/SUFFICIENT review and a current accepted record; PARTIAL is not sufficient.
history_model.event_contracts: Known event_type values are explicitly mapped to entity_type, domain, and permitted state transitions in src/evidence_lifecycle.py.
history_model.immutability_limit: Application validation is not a digital signature, tamper-proof hash chain, WORM store, authenticated identity provider, or transactional persistence layer. A coordinated rewrite of records, events, and their pointers cannot be independently detected without trusted storage/integrity controls.
